messages:
henry: Quick sanity check on the Policies list — adding retention presets and a Legal Hold badge. figma: https://figma.com/file/zzz/policies (frame: presets-compact). can we review copy + badges + audit wording + color contrast?

maya: love the presets. nit: "Legal Hold" badge needs clearer affordance. Users expect it to be persistent and slightly more prominent than a temporary flag.

sara: Confirmation modal copy when toggling Legal Hold: current = `Enable legal hold?`. Suggest fuller: `Enable legal hold for this policy? This prevents automatic deletion until removed.` and include a secondary line: `This action is reversible but must be removed manually.`

omar: Audit log: include action_type, actor_email, policy_id, before/after, legal_hold=true/false, kms_owner. machine-readable fields only. Also add human-friendly text for the UI audit view.

liz: KMS label nits: please avoid `Managed key` alone. Proposed: `Redwood-managed (platform)` and `Customer-managed (BYOK)` — the parenthetical clarifies who controls key storage. Avoid wording implying we can decrypt customer data.

katie: A11y: Legal Hold badge color fails AA contrast on the red variant. Two options: increase contrast or add a lock icon within the badge so color isn't the only differentiator. Also ensure badges have aria-labels like `Legal hold: enabled`.

henry: Good. For presets: show `30 days`, `90 days (recommended)`, `Custom`. Include a tooltip for recommended explaining cost/retention tradeoffs.

omar: Example audit event (machine):
```
2026-01-15T16:12:09Z policy.update actor=liz@example.com policy_id=pol_202 action=legal_hold:enable before=retention=90d legal_hold=false after=legal_hold=true kms_owner=customer region=us-west-2 source=console
```

sara: Human audit entry for UI: `Legal hold enabled for policy "Customer Data Export" by liz@example.com. Retention remains 90 days. Key: Customer-managed (BYOK).` Keep it explicit.

katie: Also ensure the legal hold toggle is reachable by keyboard and has a descriptive aria-pressed state. When turned on, announce `Legal hold enabled for policy: Customer Data Export` with aria-live=polite.

infra-bot: Added schema ticket INF-814 to track kms_owner + legal_hold fields in audit pipeline.

henry: Action items: liz to update labels and modal copy, katie to propose color/icon variants for badge, omar/infrastructure to add fields, sara to draft final UX microcopy for presets. will update figma tonight. (reacted :rocket:)
